issue: Graph node click does not open document view
actual: Clicking a graph node (e.g. redis-caching) only marks it 'selected' within the Knowledge Graph tab; the active nav tab remains 'Knowledge Graph' and no document content is shown. The user must manually click the 'Documents' tab afterward to see the document, which contradicts 'opens that document in the document view without requiring a separate tab change'.

evidence: App exposes Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites nav tabs; clicking each activates that view (nav state 'active' toggles accordingly) and content changes appropriately.

Set Redis Caching Strategy doc with cache-patterns closed / cache-invalidation open, graph zoom at 140%. Switched Graph->Favorites->Documents->Graph; selected document, section states, and zoom level (140%) all remained unchanged across all switches.

Favoriting redis-caching and jwt-authentication updated nav.favorites.count immediately (1 then 2). Markers survived sorting by date and filtering to AUTH/All modules. Favorites view listed both docs regardless of Documents module filter. After a full page reload, favorites count remained 2 and both markers stayed 'on', confirming local persistence.
Searching 'zzzznonexistentquery' displayed message 'No documents found - Try adjusting your search or filter criteria'; clearing the search restored all 19 documents in the list.
